wins: Mapped initial network perimeter quickly, identifying key services (SSH, HTTP) within the first five minutes and documenting their versions for targeted exploits.
Maintained situational awareness via mentor check-ins, allowing rapid course corrections when enumeration data conflicted with initial hypotheses.
fails: Failed to obtain valid credentials after repeated SSH brute-force attempts, leaving lateral movement stalled.
Did not successfully exploit identified HTTP service misconfigurations, resulting in zero privilege escalation and mission success.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough and data-rich, but follow-up exploitation and credential acquisition steps consistently stalled, preventing mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: SSH brute-force attempts consumed time without yielding credentials, slowing progress and increasing detection risk.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner observed showing service version
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripting engine and gather supported algorithms

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP server responds with verbose headers and outdated server string
skill_cards.then_action: Use nikto + dirsearch chaining to discover hidden endpoints and configuration leaks

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH enumeration yields banner but brute force fails
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to password spraying using known default lists with lockout monitoring

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase delivering actionable SSH metadata.

next_experiments.title: Focused Credential Harvesting
next_experiments.description: Pivot from brute force to targeted password spraying combined with monitoring for lockouts and adaptive delay to preserve access opportunities.

next_experiments.title: HTTP Misconfiguration Exploit Run
next_experiments.description: Chain nikto-detected issues with a bespoke exploit script against the outdated HTTP server to gain command execution.
